So a failed PostCreator#create leaves no embed record, no logging, and repeated doomed retrievals (subject only to the 60s redis throttle). Whether PostCreator actually returns nil in realistic cases isn't shown in the diff, so confidence is moderate.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the create path wraps `PostCreator.new(...).create` in a transaction but only creates a `TopicEmbed` row if `post.present?`; if `PostCreator#create` returns nil (for any failure that doesn’t raise), `import` returns nil with no logging/exception and no `TopicEmbed` record is created. In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading`; `loading.html.erb` reloads every 30s, causing repeated enqueues while `topic_id_for_embed` remains nil. `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`/`TopicRetriever` don’t surface the failure, so the iframe can remain on the loading page indefinitely in this scenario.
